name: KontextBench
intro: KontextBench 是 FLUX.1 Kontext 论文提出的上下文图像生成与编辑基准，包含 108 张基础图像和 1,026 个独特图像—提示词对，覆盖局部编辑、全局编辑、文本编辑、风格参考和角色参考五类真实使用场景。官方公开快照是仅含输入、没有目标图像的单一测试集。
build_method: 众包真实用例；更细采集、标注与质检协议未披露
metric: 五类任务人工 ELO 评分, 角色参考 AuraFace 相似度中位数, 1024×1024 图像到图像时延中位数, 独立多轮 AuraFace 余弦漂移
task_type: 图像编辑, 图像参考生成
eval_feature: 单轮基准评测；独立多轮角色漂移研究
scale: 1,026 个测试集图像—提示词对 / 108 张基础图像
build_method_en: Crowdsourced real-world use cases; finer collection, annotation, and quality-control protocols are not reported
eval_feature_en: Single-turn benchmark evaluation; separate multi-turn character-drift study
intro_en: KontextBench is the in-context image generation and editing benchmark introduced with FLUX.1 Kontext. It contains 108 base images and 1,026 unique image-prompt pairs across local editing, global editing, text editing, style reference, and character reference tasks collected from real use cases. The official public snapshot is a single input-only test split with no target images.
metric_en: Five-category human ELO ratings, median AuraFace similarity for character reference, median 1024×1024 image-to-image latency, separate multi-turn AuraFace cosine drift

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2506.15742v2 Sections 4.1–4.3 and Figures 7, 8, and 12; the official FLUX.1 Kontext release repo commit 57ce4051906a986d39c3ec51571b32c239c7d165; and the official black-forest-labs/kontext-bench dataset snapshot fb9b2cb88bb41632b81a02c4f98fa33b00941f92. The construction flow stops at the reported evidence boundary: crowd-sourced real-world use cases and a 108-base-image pool converge on 1,026 unique image-prompt pairs, divided exactly into 416 local, 262 global, 92 text, 63 style-reference, and 193 character-reference items. No filtering, annotation, quality-control, deduplication, or split-construction protocol is invented. The pinned public artifact is one test split containing 108 JPEGs plus 1,026 metadata.jsonl rows with file_name, instruction, category, key, image_idx, and prompt_idx; it contains inputs only, with no target images, baseline samples, evaluation code, or raw human votes. Although the dataset metadata is tagged MIT, its README states that the benchmark and included images are for scientific and research purposes only. The paper's promise to publish reported baseline samples is therefore not represented as fulfilled. Single-turn outputs branch in parallel to five-category human ELO ratings, median AuraFace input-versus-edited similarity for character reference, and median 1024×1024 image-to-image latency. The exact human protocol and ELO settings, AuraFace subset and similarity rule, generation parameters, and latency setup are unreported. The multi-turn AuraFace cosine comparison between the input and successive edits is shown as a separate character-drift study, not as the next stage of the 1,026-pair benchmark. No official dynamic leaderboard is claimed.
